impact.title: Measurable impact
impact.lead: Real numbers from my recent roles. Open each one for the context.

items.label: components consolidated in Experian's design system
items.title: 70+ components
body: I consolidated a library of more than 70 components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), aligned with production, so design and engineering work from the same pieces.
The result: a more scalable, maintainable and consistent product across the B2B site and the corporate blog.

items.label: of the system rebuilt and documented
items.title: 40% rebuilt
body: I inherited a design system with low technical and documentation maturity. I rebuilt more than 40% of its components, set documentation standards and fixed visual inconsistencies.
Every component is now documented so engineering can use it without depending on design.

items.label: user retention through redesigned flows
items.title: +25% retention
body: As Wiggot's design lead, I built usability flows with stakeholders and product managers, validated with wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes in user testing.
Those flows increased user retention by 25%.

items.label: workshops and talks across Mexico
items.title: 100+ workshops and talks
body: Over five years I delivered more than 100 workshops and talks on user experience, innovation and human-centered methods.
Venues include Talent Land, UNAM, UANL, Jalisco's Ministry of Innovation and CONTPAQi.

about.title: About
about.lead: I design so teams make better decisions.
paragraphs: I'm from Guadalajara, live in Oaxaca, and studied Graphic Communication Design at Universidad de Guadalajara. I've spent over ten years across graphic design, innovation, content and digital product.

I started in CONTPAQi's marketing team, then facilitated Design Thinking and LEGO® Serious Play® workshops; today I design and maintain Experian's design system for the US market. I like taking complex products and making them clear for the people who use them and sustainable for the people who build them.

steps.text: Before moving a pixel I look at Hotjar, Adobe Analytics and what users say in testing. Design decisions are defended with evidence, not taste.
I design components with tokens and variables in Figma, documented so engineering can ship them without asking me. A change happens once and reaches the whole product.
steps.alt: Wiggot design system foundations based on Material Design

steps.text: not on the sidelines. I join grooming, refinement and planning with Product Owners and engineers in Jira, and check accessibility against WCAG 2.2 before handoff.
steps.alt: Design system documentation process shared with the team

steps.text: to get to testing sooner. I prototype in code with Claude Code and research with Claude to validate ideas in days, not weeks.

facilitation.title: Facilitation
facilitation.lead: 100+ workshops and talks over five years across Mexico on human-centered innovation.

methods.name: Design Thinking
methods.title: Design Thinking
body: Stanford d.school's approach to solving problems from people's needs: empathize, define, ideate, prototype and test.
I taught it in workshops for teams and universities, and it's how I start every product project.

methods.name: Serious Play
methods.title: LEGO® Serious Play®
body: A method where teams build models with LEGO® bricks to think with their hands, align ideas and surface assumptions.
I used it to facilitate strategy and co-creation sessions with cross-functional teams.

methods.name: Working Backwards
methods.title: Working Backwards
body: Amazon's customer-first method: write the press release and FAQ for the product first, then build it.
I taught it to focus initiatives on the real problem before designing solutions.

methods.name: Innovation
methods.title: Board of Innovation
body: Board of Innovation templates and exercises to map opportunities, prioritize ideas and design experiments.
I brought them into workshops to move from ideation to concrete tests.
